shortDescription: CTERA Portal Active Directory configuration and management

options.name: domain
options.description: Active Directory domain to connect to. Required if C(state) is connected

options.name: domain_controllers
options.description: Configure a primary and a secondary domain controllers

options.name: force_reconnect
options.description: Disconnect and connect even if connected to the domain

options.name: krb
options.description: Connect to Active Directory over Kerberos

options.name: ou
options.description: The OU path to use when connecting to the active directory services

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the user for communicating with the Active Directory Service. Required if C(state) is connected

options.name: ssl
options.description: Connect to Active Directory over SSL

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the Edge Filer is connected to an Active Directory domain

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of the tenant. For Global Admin operations set to "$admin" Use default if not provided. Do not set for initialization operations

options.name: username
options.description: User Name to for communicating with the Active Directory Service. Required if C(state) is connected
